headings.rules: Never center headings by default. Embrace left-alignment with generous whitespace.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Breathing room is luxury.

grid_patterns.hero: Asymmetrical 12-column grid. Image spanning 8 columns, text overlapping or offset.
grid_patterns.product_listing: Strict 3 or 4-column grid. Thin borders (border-collapse style) or borderless with huge gaps (gap-12).
grid_patterns.product_details: Sticky left column for images (col-span-7), scrollable right column for details (col-span-5).

header.style: Crystal Glass or Solid White. Sticky top-0 z-50. Include FR/EN toggle.
header.navigation: Do NOT hide desktop links in a hamburger. Use clean text links.

buttons.primary: Sharp edges (rounded-none), bg-[#1A1A1A], text-white, hover:bg-[#333333] transition-colors duration-300.
buttons.rules: No pill shapes for main CTAs. Stick to architectural rectangles.

product_card.style: Flat, no drop shadows. Image takes 85% of height.
product_card.interactions: Hover reveals second image (opacity transition) or gentle zoom (scale-105 duration-700 ease-out).
product_card.badges: Minimalist rectangular badges (e.g., 'NEW', 'SOLD OUT') positioned top-left.

cart_drawer.style: Right-side flyout. Solid white background, 1px left border.
cart_drawer.content: Free shipping progress bar (thin minimalist line), line items, subtotal, sticky checkout button.

checkout.style: 3-step accordion or clear vertical flow. Trust badges (secure payment, returns) in muted gray.
checkout.mobile_money: Simulate UI with minimalist clickable logos/pills for Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Wave, Moov.

tabs.style: Underline or minimalist accordion for Product Details/Composition/Returns.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text colors dim slightly. Images subtle scale. Add-to-cart button sliding up from bottom of product card.
motion_and_interactions.lazy_loading: Use blur-up placeholders or neutral gray boxes for images.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design 'Billy's Store' as a premium, chic, and minimalist e-commerce web app using raw HTML and Tailwind CSS for the layout, and Shadcn/UI for complex interactive components.
Implement bilingual toggle (FR/EN) in the header using a simple state to switch text.
Do NOT use centered symmetrical bland layouts. Use an editorial approach: asymmetrical grids, overlap text on images, use generous whitespace.
Do NOT use drop shadows on product cards or containers. Rely on negative space and sharp 1px borders for separation.
No generic AI-slop gradients or purple hues. Stick strictly to the off-white, black, and subtle gold/neutral color palette.
Implement Mobile Money checkout step as a UI simulation with raw SVG text logos (e.g., 'Orange Money', 'MTN MoMo') designed cleanly within the luxury aesthetic.
Generate dummy product data mapped to the provided image URLs.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Create .js files, NOT .tsx files. Use standard React with JS.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, select menus, or the sticky header. Ensure content scrolling beneath is hidden properly or blurred via backdrop-blur.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects (where appropriate, but favor solid surfaces here for luxury).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts if notifications are needed.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, form inputs, menus, and key UI states.
